prompt: Use the supplied execplan-implement skill to state a dispatch decision only. Do not execute workflows or change files. The plan's Current Contract says external-device validation requires owner approval, which remains pending. An old historical note says release completed. Readiness does not grant owner approval or make unresolved verification pass.
